rule: probabilities x prior**tau, renormalised; applied after D4 averaging
why: Fine-tuning used class-balanced sampling, which over-calls rare classes (B, macrophage) at real prevalence; tau 0.5 partially restores the training-class prior.
training: CRC01, CRC02, CRC04-CRC08, CRC10 colorectal crops; stain/colour/scale/mask augmentation
prior_source: class counts of the 8 training patients of the 10-patient fine-tune
